svg.desc: Bel Egypt Office and Factory LOCATION Cairo, Egypt CLIENT Bel Egypt COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2012 450,000 Euros DISCIPLINES Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview The project scope consisted of 4 main components: 1- Construction of underground water tank 2- Extension of administration building 3- Construction of chemical store 4- Design & Supervision for MEP network. BECT's scope included detailed drawings and site supervision. The multidisciplinary services covered mechanical engineering and electrical engineering.
